top_signals.title: Nigeria’s NNPC Takes $4.5 Billion Loan for Nation’s Priorities
top_signals.summary: Nigeria said it approved a $4.5 billion arrangement with the state-owned energy firm that will liberate funds to bolster foreign-exchange reserves and spending on the government’s ongoing infrastructure priorities.
